text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Trainer! You're a person 
of your word, truly impressive.
choice_data_list:
...I was actually planning to get a 
thousand of them, though...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, no, one is plenty. Besides, it really 
didn't fit that much in the first place.
choice_data_list: ……本当は千個取るつもりだったのに
choice_data_list_en: ...I was actually planning on getting a thousand of them, though.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are you wearing?! And 
besides, if it's on your legs, it won't 
even affect your playing, right?
choice_data_list: 脚の拘束具さえ外せばいけたはず……
choice_data_list_en: If only I could take off these leg restraints, I would've made it...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why are you practice-swinging now?! And 
your swing count is ridiculously low!!
choice_data_list: 素振り12回からやり直しだ
choice_data_list_en: Start over from the twelfth swing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What am I gonna do with you? 
Every time I look at this kid, I feel like 
I'm gonna burst out laughin'.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
People might get suspicious if they see it 
with me. So please, let me keep this child 
in the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It won't be a problem if you laugh over 
there.
